ABOUT TYT STEEL
Tianjin Tianyingtai Steel Pipe Co., Ltd. is located in Jinghai county, Tianjin, producing and supplying various steel pipes (round/square/rectangular/ precision) and other related steel products. We adopt advanced production equipments and perfect our quality management. We maintain the recognized ISO 9001 Quality Management accreditation and BV certification to ensure we meet the highest standards. Now, we have a total of eight HighFrequency welded lines in 55,000 square meter factory. Last year, annual production capacity reached 400,000 tons and trading capacity reached 300,000 tons, normal sizes of which range from 10X10 to 400X400, OD16MM to OD610MM. Our products are applied in different industries and are exported to various areas worldwide.
